title: The linearized minimal surfaces problem
summary: We characterize the kernel of the linearization $R$ of the minimal surface problem about the Euclidean metric in a bounded smooth domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, $n\ge2$, with the background minimal surfaces being the Euclidean planes. We show that, in the whole-space Euclidean decomposition, the kernel consists of potential fields and TT fields. For bounded domains, a similar phenomenon appears with additional boundary coupling conditions; in particular, the TT part may be coupled to a harmonic conformal component.
